indices.description: ndarray of ints This array must contain integers in ``[0, n-1]``, where n is the number of choices.

choices.description: sequence of arrays Choice arrays. The index array and all of the choices should be broadcastable to the same shape.

out.description: array, optional If provided, the result will be inserted into this array. It should be of the appropriate shape and `dtype`.

mode.description: {'raise', 'wrap', 'clip'}, optional Specifies how out-of-bounds indices will behave.
